name: Janna
source:
A naive orphan from the city of Zaun, who got kicked out of the orphanage as soon as she reached the age of majority. Penniless and homeless, she is trying to find her place in life.

Janna displays an ability to cast wind magic and has a familiar named Spot, whom only she can see.
